selection_disclosure: Every V1-V4 quote, basis sample, match review and relation episode is discovery or infrastructure history and contributes zero V5 promotion evidence.

certified_terminal_lock.eligibility: current content-hashed rules, exact identifiers and a deterministic worst-state payoff proof
certified_terminal_lock.claim: A terminal lock exists only after both complete simulated legs fill; non-atomic orphan risk is reported separately.

rule_aware_convergence.eligibility: operator-approved score above 0.80, no hard rule mismatch, fresh synchronized A/B books
rule_aware_convergence.claim: Risky statistical convergence only. Resolver mismatch, non-convergence and capital duration remain loss modes.

synchronization.causality: latest state from each venue available at the decision cut

execution.entry: walk equal-share quantity through both executable ask books
execution.costs: all four venue taker fees, doubled-cost view, and one adverse tick per leg
execution.capital: $500 shared total, initially $250 per venue, with displayed depth and venue minimums
execution.jurisdiction: paper observation only; no Kalshi order path on the Dublin host

evaluation.independent_unit: first eligible episode per match, direction and UTC day
evaluation.multiple_testing: Holm correction across both products, direction, horizon and every reviewed matching variant
evaluation.null_outcome: No terminal locks or no post-fee convergence is a valid result.
